paite: Huan Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat kum sawm-le-giat alal kum in Ahab tapa Jehoram Israelte tung ah Samaria ah alal pan a; kum sawm-le-nih alal hi.
heading: Moab Leh Israel Kidouna
english: Now Jehoram the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria in the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned twelve years.

paite: TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoihloupi ahih a; himahleh anu leh apa bang tel in zaw thil ahih kei. Ama'n apa Baal suangphuh apaimang hi.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, but not like his father and like his mother, for he put away the pillar of Baal that his father had made.

paite: Himahleh, Israelte thil hihkhialsak Nebat tapa Jeroboam khelhnate amah ah abelh tinten a; huai apaisan kei hi.
english: Nevertheless he held to the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin. He didn’t depart from them.

paite: Moab kumpipa Mesha belam vul mi ahi a; ama'n Israel kumpipa kiang ah belamnou nuaikhat mul leh belampa nuaikhat mul siah aliau hi.
english: Now Mesha king of Moab was a sheep breeder; and he supplied the king of Israel with one hundred thousand lambs and the wool of one hundred thousand rams.

paite: Himahleh Ahab sih nung in hichi ahong hi a, Moab kumpipa Israel kumpipa tung ah ahelta hi.
english: But when Ahab was dead, the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel.

paite: Huchih lai in Samaria a pan kumpipa Jehoram apawt a, Israel tengteng akaikhawm vek hi.
english: King Jehoram went out of Samaria at that time, and mustered all Israel.

paite: Huchi in apawt a, Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat kiang ah, "Moab kumpipa ka tung ah ahel a, Moabte na hon doupih diam?" chi in mi asawl hi. Ama'n, "Hon doupih e, kei leh nang, ka mite leh na mite pum khat i hi ua, ka sakolte leh na sakolte leng pum khat ahi uh," achi hi.
english: He went and sent to Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, saying, “The king of Moab has rebelled against me. Will you go with me against Moab to battle?” He said, “I will go up. I am as you are, my people as your people, my horses as your horses.”

paite: Amah mah in, "Koi lampi ah ahia i kuan touh ding?" achi hi. Ama'n adawng a, "Edom gamdai lampi ah," achi hi.
english: Then he said, “Which way shall we go up?” Jehoram answered, “The way of the wilderness of Edom.”

paite: Huchi in Israel kumpipa Judah kumpipa toh, Edom kumpipa toh, akuanta ua; ni sagih apaikual ua; asepaihte leh agan tonpihte dawn ding tui a-omta kei hi.
english: So the king of Israel went with the king of Judah and the king of Edom, and they marched for seven days along a circuitous route. There was no water for the army or for the animals that followed them.

paite: Israel kumpipa'n, "E heh he! TOUPA'N kumpipa thumte Moabte khut a piak dia hon pikhawm ahi peuhmah ve,” achi hi.
english: The king of Israel said, “Alas! For Yahweh has called these three kings together to deliver them into the hand of Moab.”

paite: Himahleh Jehoshaphat in, "Hiai ah TOUPA hon dotsak ding TOUPA zawlnei kuahiam bek a-om kei maw?" achi hi. Israel kumpipa sikha khat in adawng a, "Elijah khut tui buaksekpa Shaphat tapa Elisha hiai a om ei ve," achi hi.
english: But Jehoshaphat said, “Isn’t there a prophet of Yahweh here, that we may inquire of Yahweh by him?” One of the king of Israel’s servants answered, “Elisha the son of Shaphat, who poured water on the hands of Elijah, is here.”

paite: Jehoshaphat in, akiang ah, "Ama'n TOUPA thu anei hi," achi hi. Huchi in Israel kumpipa leh Jehoshaphat leh Edom kumpipa akiang ah ahohsukta uh.
english: Jehoshaphat said, “Yahweh’s word is with him.” So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him.

paite: Elisha in Israel kumpipa kiang ah, "Nang leh ke'n kizopna bang i nei a? Na pa zawlneite leh na nu zawlneite kiang ah va hoh in," achi hi. Israel kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Pai lou e; kumpipa thumte Moabte khut a piak ding in TOUPA'N ahon pikhawm hi,” achi hi.
english: Elisha said to the king of Israel, “What have I to do with you? Go to the prophets of your father, and to the prophets of your mother.” The king of Israel said to him, “No, for Yahweh has called these three kings together to deliver them into the hand of Moab.”

paite: Elisha in, "Akiang a ka dinna sepaihte' TOUPA ahin bang in ka gen ahi. Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat zahtak lou hi leng nang lam leng ka nga kei dia, muh leng ka hon mu het kei ding.
english: Elisha said, “As Yahweh of Armies lives, before whom I stand, surely, were it not that I respect the presence of Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, I would not look toward you, nor see you.

paite: Himahleh, kaihging tumsiammi hon sam un," achi hi. Kaihging tumsiam in ahon tumleh, hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA khut atung ah ahong omta hi.
english: But now bring me a musician.” When the musician played, Yahweh’s hand came on him.

paite: Ama'n, TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Hiai phaizang tengteng toukuak tektuk un.
english: He said, “Yahweh says, ‘Make this valley full of trenches.’

paite: TOUPA mah in hichi in achi: Huih himhim na mu kei ding ua, vuah himhim leng na mu sam kei ding uh. Himahleh hiai phaizang tui in adim vek ding hi. Huchi in nou leh na bawnghonte uh leh na gante un adawn ding uh.
english: For Yahweh says, ‘You will not see wind, neither will you see rain, yet that valley will be filled with water, and you will drink, both you and your livestock and your other animals.

paite: Hiai TOUPA ngaih in thil neuchik lel ahi a; Moabte na khut uah ahon piak behlap ding hi.
english: This is an easy thing in Yahweh’s sight. He will also deliver the Moabites into your hand.

paite: Kulhpi nei khua tengteng leh khopi hoih tengteng na hihse ding ua, sing hoih tengteng na phuk ding ua, tuikhuk tengteng na hubing ding ua, mun hoih tata suang in na dengse vek ding uh," achi hi.
english: You shall strike every fortified city and every choice city, and shall fell every good tree, and stop all springs of water, and mar every good piece of land with stones.’”

paite: Zingsang in, thillat lat hun lai in hichi ahong hi a, ngai in, Edom gam lam a pan tui ahong luang a, tui in agam ahong dimta hi.
english: In the morning, about the time of offering the sacrifice, behold, water came by the way of Edom, and the country was filled with water.

paite: Moab tengteng in amau sual ding in kumpipate ahong kuantou uh chih ana zak un, galdou thei chiang tengteng ana kikaikhawm ua, gamgi ah ana pangta uhi.
english: Now when all the Moabites heard that the kings had come up to fight against them, they gathered themselves together, all who were able to put on armor, young and old, and stood on the border.

paite: Huchi in zingkhang in athou ua, ni in tui tung a hon salvak a, Moabte'n azawn ua tui sisan bang a san in amu uhi.
english: They rose up early in the morning, and the sun shone on the water, and the Moabites saw the water opposite them as red as blood.

paite: "Sisan ei ve, kumpipate amau le amau akidou ua, amau leh amau kithat uh ahi mahmah ve. Kisa un, Moabte aw, gallak thil i va tuh ding uh,” achi uhi.
english: They said, “This is blood. The kings are surely destroyed, and they have struck each other. Now therefore, Moab, to the plunder!”

paite: Israelte giahphual ava tun uleh, Israelte ahong thou phut ua, Moabte asual ua, huchi in ama uah ataikek uh. Moabte that kawm in agam uah adelhlutta uhi.
english: When they came to the camp of Israel, the Israelites rose up and struck the Moabites, so that they fled before them; and they went forward into the land attacking the Moabites.

paite: Khuate ahihsia ua; amun hoih tata teng uh michih in adeng ua, suang in adimgawpta hi. Tuikhuk tengteng ahubing ua, sing hoih tengteng aphuk ua; Kir-hareseth a om suangte kia akhoih kei uhi. Huai leng vaisuanglot tawi pawl in a-umkimvel ua, asual uhi.
english: They beat down the cities; and on every good piece of land each man cast his stone, and filled it. They also stopped all the springs of water and cut down all the good trees, until in Kir Hareseth all they left was its stones; however the men armed with slings went around it and attacked it.

paite: Moab kumpipa'n akidou uh zou ding in akitheita kei, Edom kumpipa kiang a tung dia phut paisuak tum in namsau tawimi zasagih apikhia a, himahleh alohsam uhi.
english: When the king of Moab saw that the battle was too severe for him, he took with him seven hundred men who drew a sword, to break through to the king of Edom; but they could not.

paite: Huchi in atapa upapen, asik a hong lal ding pen kulh dawn ah halmang thillat in alanta hi. Huchi in Israelte atung ah aheh mahmah ua, akisa ua, agam uah apaikik nawnta uhi.
english: Then he took his oldest son who would have reigned in his place, and offered him for a burnt offering on the wall. There was great wrath against Israel; and they departed from him, and returned to their own land.
